title: Core ROM Axioms — L0-L7 Genome
essence: Seven constitutional axioms (bets-not-facts, no-decide-for-you, time-quality-first-class, structure-earned, repair-visibly, history-teacher-not-jailer, irreversibility-declared) generate the L0-L7 stack; each layer maps to one axiom.

title: L6 cross-session pattern recognition (ROM candidate)
essence: Cross-session pattern recognition requires a dense receipt substrate; architecturally specified but not implemented — promote to ROM when Observatory trajectory analysis is live and tested.

title: L7 meta-governance enforcement (ROM candidate)
essence: L7 meta-governance constitutional enforcement behavior across the full stack — specified by axiom VII but not yet implemented; promote when L7 is specified and built.

title: Cadence-error is predominant failure mode (EMPIRICAL candidate)
essence: Claim that the most common high-stakes failure is analysis at the wrong moment in the decision lifecycle; cannot be proven logically — needs Observatory frequency data across error types.

title: W-field inference / cadence / drift / kairos ROM
essence: Constitutional rules for Window inference, cadence NCI-lens scoring, receipt age-decay, DRIFT Sentinel (5-turn threshold), Kairos Lock trigger, and LAB/BAR/KKL/ATG macro auto-fire conditions.

title: Kintsugi Immune System primitive
essence: Repair seams visibly; no silent patching of integrity failures — show the break and the gold. A 6th ROM primitive not in the canonical v9 five-primitive set.

title: Write-Lock primitive
essence: One-way-gate decisions require explicit write-lock declaration before commit; irreversibility is declared, not assumed. A 7th ROM primitive beyond the canonical v9 five.

title: COCD as first-class UX primitive
essence: Surface the Calibrate-Orient-Chart-Detect loop as the primary UX frame on arcs.care, replacing the generic hero.

title: Design system canonicalization
essence: Recover the Register-pattern Badge/Button/Card from arcs-app git history as a canonical inline-style component library rather than ad-hoc per-page styles.

title: arcs.care PLG Phase 1 — model swap + Lab offer
essence: Which model powers the live compass and where the Lab offer card surfaces post-result to maximise free-to-paid conversion.

title: Conversion architecture — founding-10 build sequence
essence: Correct build sequence for closing arcs.care founding-10 conversion given warm-traffic referrals; hero redesign is a third-order move, not first.

title: CI/CD governance — NOTOMATION circuit breaker
essence: Automation authority ceiling for CI/CD that enforces NOTOMATION (ROM #1) via circuit breakers without blocking automated build-failure repair.

title: Case-study content dependency gate
essence: Missing shareable founding-client outcome blocks only the case-study build; email capture and spots badge proceed independently.

title: Anonymous vs authenticated compass
essence: Compass runs anonymously with optional post-session account creation (Option C); auth is a soft nudge, not a gate — biggest PLG lever.

title: receipt-core canonical schema
essence: Canonical compass-receipt field set lives in dewy-receipt-schema-v1.json so arcs.care (Supabase) and arcs-v9 (Prisma) cannot drift.

title: /helpful raw-paste vs structured form
essence: Whether to replace the 5-field structured input with a single raw-context paste, delegating structure extraction to the engine. Status DRAFT/HELD pending Architect packet.

title: ReceiptObject as wire/storage type
essence: ReceiptObject (Pydantic) is the wire/storage format only; DecisionReceipt stays the internal operator type — not a full runtime replacement.

title: Tribune Intelligence Layer
essence: Three-phase annotation system (Anterior pre-mortem / Proactive silent-kinematic / Posterior post-mortem) wrapping the Receipt flow without mutating the sealed ReceiptObject.

title: Network+Calendar forensic DEWY receipt
essence: Cross-domain scan (Network Builder-dominant OM vs Calendar Focused-Executor) yields PARTIAL alignment, 1 FORK signal, WEAK echo, YELLOW conviction; top OM Barbara Emery.

title: ADR-016 prod-unblock post-mortem
essence: Four silent prod failures (PrismaPg SSL config-object form, missing emailVerified column, stale CLI-upload deploy, Marketplace DB creds) — green build != working DB; verify real query first.

title: Architect/Implementor state sync
essence: Zero-infra Architect-Implementor context sync via git-committed _STATE/snapshot.json + raw.githubusercontent curl; snapshot is ground truth, /handoff writes it, /handoff-pickup reads it.

title: Firehose is a geometry problem
essence: Decision overload isn't a focus/volume problem but the absence of a ground position; dashboards orient to nothing because they reduce flow instead of giving a coordinate.

title: Court agency boundary — relief test
essence: The Court surfaces, never deliberates; the practical test for Court territory: if a system verdict would feel like relief rather than information, you have crossed into it.

title: Frozen Court Problem + receipt-as-hypothesis
essence: A memory-with-no-learning fossilizes (cites its own priors as authority); fix is treating each receipt as an open hypothesis in states pending/live, with a verification gate declared at session-close.

title: Multi-agent shared court
essence: Extends the single-sovereign court to multi-party decisions: Initiator/Respondent/Witness roles, binary standing, structural vs awareness binding, and a mandatory Dissent Record so a joint receipt isn't one person's decision with another's name on it.

title: Triune logic + canon reference
essence: Three truth states replace binary: NULL (looked, found nothing) vs OM (present, resolved) vs UNDEFINED (not yet evaluated); do not collapse UNDEFINED to NULL — different failure modes.

title: DEWY receipt schema governance
essence: Receipt = frozen L0-L5 state vector, not a document; only PASS gets full DEWY decomposition, HOLD/REJECT emit stubs; no breaking change without a v2 file; render_resolution derived not authored.

title: Layered receipt-type taxonomy
essence: Canonical registry classifying receipts by L-layer (ATOM=L0 signal, DEWY=L1-5 decision, plus others) with per-type classification signals used by a RAG hook to inject the right template shell.

title: Two-agent Architect/Implementer routing
essence: All canon work runs two cooperating agents — external Architect/Bar-Raiser (Perplexity, no file access) vs Claude Code Implementer/Editor; first session decision is routing the task to the right one.

title: SPEC-vs-IMPL honest cartography
essence: Flow doc pairs every stage's SPEC (governing target) with IMPL (what the route does today) and an explicit IMPL NOTE where they diverge — impl notes are honest cartography, not bugs to hide.

title: Compass atomic-design gate status
essence: Canon-derived atomic UI spec (11 atoms) with explicit per-atom gate status — UI-only atoms UNBLOCKED, session/receipt/NCI atoms BLOCKED behind auth+prod gates.
